recommendation: Keep this audit commit. Future changes to targetInvariant or targetConstraint should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions, while core should continue to reference the current Extension Pack artifact rather than restoring old core extension definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-28572 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR core Measure and requested a cqf-targetInvariant extension for definitional artifacts, with key, requirements, severity, and expression children evaluated against %target and %definition so definitions could state validation rules for instantiated resources.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 69dc0e04cd5351136bb1ed6e884fa71bddd7cf3e applied the issue by adding targetInvariant rows to source/profiles/clinicalreasoning-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, including the requested key, requirements, severity, and expression elements. No prior combined-branch commit had an Issue-Reconcile-Key trailer for FHIR-28572.
additional_context: FHIR core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source, and the current active clinicalreasoning-extensions spreadsheet has an empty Extensions worksheet. The authoritative extension definitions now live in the FHIR Extension Pack: cqf-targetInvariant still exists there but is retired/deprecated, and FHIR-45313 created targetConstraint as the active replacement. FHIR-53078 updated the current core Clinical Reasoning page to list and link targetConstraint through the configured extension location.
reconciliation: Made no core source changes and published an empty external-repo audit commit. Reintroducing cqf-targetInvariant rows into core would be wrong for the current build because the extension source is external and the current core narrative already points implementers to the active targetConstraint extension.
